Name: Tiny Bad Beach Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
yeah, so this farm is for bad beaches, if you're not then you should probably download this mod to be one, if you managed to reach perfection with this farm then you're gonna be crowned as the baddest beach of all time

basically this farm is stupid tiny, i took inspiration from the most tiniest farm here on nexus and since that mod is not updated yet i made thiss,

this farm spawns both forest forage and beach forage, the beach forage spawns on the sand cuz dzuhh, and the forest ones spawns in the grass cuz again, dzuhhh

if you have the Sh's Wild Animals mod or the lite version mr. beer the duckling from quiet quitting farm will appear on the pond above your farmhouse with his brother mr. whiskey,

mr, liqour stealer the dancing crab will also make an appearance alongside with mr. winemaker the sea otter and ms. bluewine the moon jelly

i recommend playing this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25942]Entrance to Narnia[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25435]Cozy Backyard﻿[/url] if you want more farming and building space
